#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>

class TextDocumentAnalysis {
public:
    static std::string input(const std::string& str) {
        int max = 0;
        int words = 0;
        bool open = false;
        size_t n = str.length();
        size_t i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            char c = str[i];
            if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
                if (c == '(') open = true;
                else if (c == ')') open = false;
                i++;
            } else {
                size_t start = i;
                while (i < n && str[i] != '_' && str[i] != '(' && str[i] != ')') {
                    i++;
                }
                int len = static_cast<int>(i - start);
                if (i < n) {
                    char d = str[i];
                    if (d == '(') {
                        if (len > max) max = len;
                        open = true;
                    } else if (d == ')') {
                        words++;
                        open = false;
                    } else { // d == '_'
                        if (open) words++;
                        else if (len > max) max = len;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (open) words++;
                    else if (len > max) max = len;
                }
            }
        }
        return std::to_string(max) + " " + std::to_string(words);
    }
};

int main() {
    std::string line;
    bool needSecond = false;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        if (needSecond) {
            std::cout << TextDocumentAnalysis::input(line) << std::endl;
        }
        needSecond = !needSecond;
    }
    if (needSecond) {
        throw std::runtime_error("NoSuchElementException");
    }
    return 0;
}
